# How to Read an Epistle Evidence Grid

**Lesson:** Y4-L13 - How to Read an Epistle

## Purpose

Support the primary activity for How to Read an Epistle.

## Instructions

1. Read the principal passage.
2. Record direct observations.
3. Separate interpretation from application.
4. Name one faithful response.

## Text

Philemon 1-25

## Big idea

A New Testament letter addresses real people and circumstances before it is applied to later readers.

## Guardrails

Read Philemon as an actual letter to real people before extracting general principles. | Do not use the letter to minimise the moral seriousness of slavery or coercive power.
